speaker: nora
headline: A SYSTEM IS ONLY REAL WHEN THE LOOP CLOSES.
deck: Announcements become governance only when implementation, monitoring, correction and delivery reconnect to the original promise.
quote: The test is not whether the system starts. The test is whether it learns enough to finish.
facts: Promises must translate into funded implementation.
Monitoring must reveal the state of delivery.
Correction must remove bottlenecks rather than explain them.
The final outcome must be visible to the public.
takeaway: Credibility is earned when the system can detect failure, repair it and still deliver the result.
